privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains, simply and transparently, what personal data we process when you visit varvi.ro or order our wines.
privacy.s1b: The varvi.ro website is operated by Casa de vinuri Maria S.R.L., registered office Str. Mihai Viteazul nr. 283D, Cricău, Alba county, Romania, tax ID (CUI) 46214932, Trade Register no. J2022000640011, the maker of VARVI wines. Under data protection law, Casa de vinuri Maria is the controller of the data described in this policy.
privacy.s2b:
This is a presentation website. It has no user accounts, no shopping basket and collects no data through forms.

  • Technical access data. The site is hosted by GitHub Pages (GitHub, Inc.). On each visit, the hosting servers may record technical data such as your IP address, the time of access and the page requested, for security and operation.
  • Order and correspondence data. When you contact us by telephone or email to order wine, we process the details you provide: name, telephone, email address, delivery address and the wines you would like.
  • Preferences stored in your browser. Your chosen language and age confirmation are kept only in your browser and never reach us. See the Cookies Policy.
privacy.s3b: We use order data to confirm availability, pricing and delivery and to fulfil your order, that is, for pre-contractual steps and the performance of a contract under Article 6(1)(b) GDPR. Technical access data is processed in our legitimate interest of keeping the site working and secure, under Article 6(1)(f) GDPR.
privacy.s4b:
We do not sell your data and do not use it for advertising. It may reach third parties only to the extent strictly necessary:

  • GitHub, Inc., as the hosting provider of the site;
  • courier companies, where needed to deliver your order;
  • public authorities, where the law requires it.
privacy.s5b: Correspondence and order data are kept for as long as needed to fulfil the order and to meet legal obligations, in particular fiscal and accounting ones, and are then deleted.
privacy.s6b: Under the GDPR you have the right to access, rectify and erase your data, to restrict processing, to data portability and to object. To exercise these rights, contact the wine house at varvy_styll@yahoo.com. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Romanian supervisory authority, ANSPDCP, at www.dataprotection.ro.
privacy.s7b: We may update this policy as the site or our services change. The current version, with the date of the last update, is always published on this page.
cookies.title: Cookies Policy
cookies.intro: This policy explains what storage technologies varvi.ro uses in your browser.
cookies.s1b: Cookies are small text files that a website can save in a visitor's browser, usually to recognise them on later visits. Similar technologies, such as local storage (localStorage), allow preferences to be saved directly in the browser.
cookies.s2b: varvi.ro is a static presentation website. It sets no cookies of its own, uses no traffic analytics, shows no advertising and embeds no social media trackers.
cookies.s3b:
For the site to work we use the browser's local storage (localStorage). This information stays on your device and is not transmitted to us:

  • varvi_lang: the language you chose for the site;
  • varvi_age_ok: your confirmation of legal drinking age, so the question does not reappear on every visit;
  • varvi_admin_ok: a technical entry used only during the pre-launch period.

They remain until you clear the site's data from your browser.
cookies.s4b: The fonts and all other page resources are served directly from varvi.ro; no data is sent to third-party services when a page opens. The site links to external services such as Google Maps and ANPC's SAL platform; once you follow those links, the policies of those services apply.
cookies.s5b: You can delete the data saved by varvi.ro at any time from your browser settings, under cookies and site data. The site remains fully usable; you will simply be asked again for your language and age confirmation.
cookies.s6b: If we ever introduce cookies or other storage technologies, this policy will be updated before they are used.

terms.s2b: The site presents alcoholic beverages and is intended exclusively for people of legal drinking age in their country, 18 years in Romania. By using the site you confirm that you meet this condition. We do not sell alcohol to minors.
terms.s3h: Role of the site and orders
terms.s3b: varvi.ro is a presentation website, not an online shop. Orders are placed by telephone or email and are arranged personally by the wine house. Availability, pricing and delivery terms are confirmed at the time of ordering; an order becomes binding only once the wine house confirms it. The information on the site, including editions and bottle counts, is informative and may be updated.
terms.withdrawB:
Orders placed by telephone or email are distance contracts under Romanian Emergency Ordinance no. 34/2014. If you are a consumer, you have the right to withdraw from the contract within 14 days without giving any reason. The period runs from the day on which you, or a person you designate other than the carrier, take physical possession of the wine.

To exercise the right of withdrawal, send us a clear statement: by email to varvy_styll@yahoo.com, by post to our registered office or by telephone on +40 745 612 366. You may use the model form below, but it is not obligatory. The deadline is met if you send your communication before the 14 days expire.

We will refund all payments received from you, including the cost of standard delivery, no later than 14 days from the day we are informed of your withdrawal, using the same means of payment as for the order unless you have expressly agreed otherwise; you will not incur any fees for the refund. We may withhold the refund until we have received the wine back or you have supplied proof of having sent it, whichever is earlier.

Please return the wine to our registered office no later than 14 days after communicating your withdrawal. You bear the direct cost of returning it. You are only liable for any diminished value of the wine resulting from handling beyond what is necessary to establish its nature and characteristics; an opened bottle can no longer be resold.

terms.s5b: We take every care to keep the published information accurate, but the site is provided as is, without guarantees that its content is complete or permanently up to date. Links to external sites are offered for convenience; we are not responsible for their content.
terms.s6b: Wine is enjoyed in moderation. We encourage responsible drinking and discourage consumption by pregnant women, by drivers and by anyone under the legal drinking age.

award.alba2025: The Alba County Small Producers’ Wine Contest, 11th edition, 2025.
sb.story: A yellow wine with green glints and intense, rich aromas of white flowers and vine tendrils, elderflower and freshly cut grass; a wine of medium body and high acidity. A touch of salt, even of gunflint, comes through as well. Perfect mineral notes.
sb.food: White fish, cheeses, white meat, steamed vegetables, seafood, pasta in a white sauce, prosciutto and fruit salads.
sb.quote: Blessed be the vine and woman, who bring the greatest joy to poor and rich alike.
award.alba2026: The Alba County Small Producers’ Wine Contest, 12th edition, 2026.
award.alba2024: The Alba County Small Producers’ Wine Contest, 10th edition, 2024.
award.vintage2022: The medal was awarded to the 2022 vintage.
award.vintage2023: The medal was awarded to the 2023 vintage.
fn.story: A barrique-aged wine: six months in oak. The grapes come from the Siria vineyards. Medium tannins and medium acidity, with red fruit, black cherry and mocha. This wine is a chameleon, thanks to the way it is made.
fn.food: Chicken, roasted vegetables, duck breast, turkey, beef. With Fetească Neagră, it is all about the sauce. So: boeuf bourguignon.
fn.quote: Invited to the wine cellar, I answered like a good Christian, with a short telegram: VIN! (In Romanian, both “wine” and “I’m coming”.)
frm.story: A dry, gentle wine with distinct notes in its fruity perfume and intense flavours on the palate. A pleasant aroma, with a slightly bitter almond finish.
frm.food: White fish, seafood, aged cheeses, smoked ham, dry-cured charcuterie, game.
rose.story: This wine is bottled poetry. It has hints of forest berries, strawberries, melon and rose petals, and a surprising taste of citrus peel. Its colour pleases the eye and brings summer and holidays to mind. This wine, then, is a state of mind.
rose.food: Salads, light dishes, starters, cheeses and, lately, salted crisps. Fish and seafood seem far better with a Rosé.
rose.quote:
That wine is good is true enough,
But you know the saying well:
Nothing ever made you drunk
The way a woman did.
frm.quote:
Two things ease my pain and ailing,
Two that soothe my every ill:
The demijohn when it is brimming
And a woman, bare and still.
